<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/vacation">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Org"
                       name="Organisation"
                       processRef="Process_VacationRequest" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" isExecutable="false">
    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Org">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Reject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteProcedures</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Approve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Submit"
                     name="Vacation request submitted" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest"
               name="Submit vacation request" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest"
               name="Receive vacation request" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approve"
                            name="Supervisor approves?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRequest"
               name="Return request to employee" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRejection"
               name="Review rejection reasons" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Reject"
                   name="Process ends (rejected)" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateNotification"
               name="Generate notification to HR Representative" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteProcedures"
               name="Complete management procedures" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approve"
                   name="Process ends (approved)" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Submit"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_Submit"
                       targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_To_Receive"
                       sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_To_Gateway"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"
                       targetRef="Gateway_Approve" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_Reject"
                       name="no"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_Approve"
                       targetRef="Task_ReturnRequest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_To_Review"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReturnRequest"
                       targetRef="Task_ReviewRejection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_To_EndReject"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejection"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Reject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_Approve"
                       name="yes"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_Approve"
                       targetRef="Task_GenerateNotification" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_To_Procedures"
                       sourceRef="Task_GenerateNotification"
                       targetRef="Task_CompleteProcedures" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_To_EndApprove"
                       sourceRef="Task_CompleteProcedures"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Approve" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
